news.text: #Sarr#Juve hits the targetThe reinforcement for #SpallettiIs #David leaving? Offer for #Zirkzee. #Yildiz undergoes surgery today.[Front Page Gazzetta dello Sport]
🔥 #BorussiaDortmund has made an inquiry for Jonathan #David. #Como and #AtléticoMadrid are also after the player.[Sky Sport via @AverageJuventinoGuy]
#Juve, #Sarr is on the way. Now either #Sørloth or #Zirkzee#Tagliafico if #Cabal leaves. #Cholo is after #David.[Front Page Corriere dello Sport]

🇸🇳🔜 "This is the night for #Sarr: details are being ironed out, #Juventus is ready to go all the way. I do not expect a shocking turnaround like the one that happened with #Kessié. In this case, the club expects to cross the finish line and bring him to Turin. HERE WE GO is expected shortly."[Fabrizio Romano - YouTube via @juventusinsidernews]

🇳🇱🧐 "The alternative path for the attack leads to #Zirkzee, who is #Juventus's preferred choice due to his technical characteristics: he is liked very much by #Spalletti and #Massara. An offer to #ManchesterUnited, but the figures are still far from what is being requested. To date, the parties are not close: an additional effort will be required if they truly want to sign him. There is also the issue of commissions, which will need to be resolved."[Fabrizio Romano & Matteo Moretto - YouTube via @juventusinsidernews]

🇩🇪🔛 "#Juventus worked late into the evening on #Woltemade. #Napoli still does not have the ok for #Lang's exit, so it is a cold path. The bianconeri have spoken with the agents and #Spalletti has spoken with the player. Contacts have intensified in the very last few hours: they tried to make progress through direct talks to sign him. #Newcastle is completely open: they are not at all opposed to the move, but it remains to be seen if la Vecchia Signora will decide to go all the way for him."[Fabrizio Romano - YouTube via @juventusinsidernews]

SARRAND NOT ONLYThe Senegalese is expected today in Turin. A maneuver by #Juve in attack as well: #Spalletti calls #Woltemade.Negotiations are down to the final details with #Tottenham. Anxiety over #Thuram is pushing to double up on midfield signings: an assault on #Hojbjerg from #Marseille and an attempt for #Bakola, but #Sassuolo is blocking the move. #David: an offer has arrived from #Atlético. Lucio is making a move for #Newcastle's German and #Zirkzee remains hot. #Cabal on his way out: the #Tagliafico idea.[Front Page TuttoSport]

#Juventus, is looking at more than just Pape #Sarr (who is increasingly close). Among the monitored players there is also Guido #Rodriguez from #Valencia. The bianconeri are searching for an experienced midfielder who fits within their financial parameters.@sportmediaset[Orazio Accomando]

🇩🇪👀 Also present on the #Juventus striker shortlist is #Woltemade (different characteristics compared to #Zirkzee) who will leave #Newcastle and has several offers.[Alfredo Pedullà via @juventusinsidernews]
Juve are presently leading the race to sign Nick Woltemade from #NUFC - @talkSPORT[Alex Crook]

#Fiorentina unlocks the arrival of #Beto. The Brazilian striker is expected in Florence in the coming hours, as reported by @SkySport. Medical tests booked. The viola club has decided to no longer wait for Joshua #Zirkzee, #Paratici's primary choice. Contacts continued even today for the Dutch forward of #ManchesterUnited but the player took more time to decide.[Matteo Moretto]

#Zirkzee has always given priority to #Juve. He is still waiting for #David's exit, because his desire remains to wear the bianconero shirt. #Juve has also spoken with the agents of #Woltemade, who has been offered to several clubs.#calciomercato[Eleonora Trotta]

#Zirkzee-#Juventus: direct contacts were holding up a month ago, during the work to close the deal for #KoloMuani, with the idea of signing two strikers. And they have continued in recent hours. It all depends on #David.[Alfredo Pedullà]
#Beto to @acffiorentina, deal on a permanent basis for 18 million to @Everton @skysport[Di Marzio]

🚨🇳🇱 Joshua Zirkzee has turned down a move to Fiorentina after €5m loan plus €30m buy option clause proposal sent to Manchester United on Wednesday.Juventus have approached Man United tonight for Zirkzee as they did with Newcastle for Woltemade, in case Jonathan David leaves.[Fabrizio Romano]

👀🆙 "#Zirkzee informed #Fiorentina this evening that he is not accepting their proposal. #Juventus is still waiting to ambush for the Dutchman: he and #Woltemade are on the shortlist to replace #David, should he leave."[Fabrizio Romano via @juventusinsidernews]
Fiorentina have reached verbal agreement with Everton to sign Beto, here we go! Deal in place with medical booked on Monday, as Skysport reported. Beto said yes to Fiorentina.[Fabrizio Romano]
🇳🇱👀 The #Zirkzee move to #Fiorentina falls through. HERE WE GO for #Beto.[Fabrizio Romano via @juventusinsidernews]
#Beto is expected in Florence for the medical tests with @acffiorentina. Green light for #Kean to @Como_1907. @SkySport[Di Marzio]

🏁⏳ "We are truly close to the finish line for #Sarr: a loan fee around €2M and an option to buy set at €26/28M. Work is also underway on the possibility of turning it into an obligation to buy, so the details of the transfer structure are currently being finalized. There is caution following the #Kessié situation, but the discussion is well advanced: he is very close to #Juventus, we are nearing the completion of the deal."[Fabrizio Romano - YouTube via @juventusinsidernews]
